description: Checks a tokenized-stock venue (TSV) against condition H of the SEC TSV Exemption (FR 2026-19388, 91 Fed. Reg. 60176, Sept. 22, 2026): a TSV must stop trading in a Tokenized NMS Stock concurrently with any stoppage of trading in the underlying NMS stock on the primary listing exchange, which includes a halt or a suspension, and must immediately notify its TSV Participants. Replays caller-supplied TSV trades against caller-declared listing-exchange stoppage intervals under a declared half-open boundary rule (start-inclusive, end-exclusive), flags every trade inside an interval beyond the caller-declared concurrency tolerance, checks that the TSV's own halt record spans each stoppage (an open-ended stoppage is covered only by an open-ended record), and reports participant-notice presence with the notice latency as a MEASURED value in milliseconds from stoppage start to the earliest notice at or after it, never graded pass/fail because the order says "immediately" without a number. Per stoppage: covered, trades_during, trades_flagged, trades_within_tolerance, notice_latency_ms; violations carry TRADE_DURING_STOPPAGE, HALT_RECORD_NOT_COVERING and NO_PARTICIPANT_NOTICE. Evidence only: it states no opinion on whether any latency, gap or trade is lawful. Zero network: the node never reads a chain and checks only what the caller supplies.

assumptions: Condition H of the SEC TSV Exemption (FR 2026-19388, 91 Fed. Reg. 60176, Sept. 22, 2026): a TSV must stop trading in a Tokenized NMS Stock concurrently with any stoppage of trading in the underlying NMS stock on the primary listing exchange, which includes a halt or a suspension, and must immediately notify its TSV Participants of any stoppage.
Stoppage intervals are HALF-OPEN: start-inclusive, end-exclusive, [start_ts, end_ts). A trade at exactly end_ts is outside the stoppage.

concurrency_tolerance_ms (caller-declared, echoed) widens the tolerated window around the interval edges: a trade with ts < start_ts + tolerance or ts >= end_ts - tolerance sits inside the interval but inside the declared tolerance and is counted without being flagged.
The order says "immediately" without a number: notice latency is reported as a measured value in milliseconds and is never graded pass/fail.

Notice latency is measured from the stoppage start to the earliest participant notice for the symbol at or after that start; an open-ended stoppage (end_ts null) is covered only by an open-ended TSV halt record.
Evidence only: this node states no opinion on whether any latency, gap or trade is lawful; it reports what the caller-supplied records show.
Zero network: the node never reads a chain and checks only the caller-supplied stoppages, trades, halt records and notices.
